theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N') (H : Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N'), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) H → (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = F x + t • (G x - F x)) → (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (0 + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) 0) (ηF ηG : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (0 + 1)), IsCompact X.support → C.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} → (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0, ∃ η₀ η₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0, (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), (η₀ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ C.boundary β = X η₁ - X η₀) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηF : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') 0) (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηG : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') 0) (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid (N + 1)), IsOpen W ∧ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} ⊆ W ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (0 + 1)) y = (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') 0) (H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ H y)) → X ηG - X ηF = C θ) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1)) (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) (k + 1)) (ηF ηG : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1)) (θ' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)), IsCompact X.support → C.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} → C'.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} → (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), ∃ η₀ η₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), (η₀ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ C.boundary β = X η₁ - X η₀ - C' β) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηF : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηG : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid (N + 1)), IsOpen W ∧ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} ⊆ W ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1 + 1)) y = (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ H y)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid (N + 1)), IsOpen W ∧ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} ⊆ W ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, (θ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) y = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ H y)) → X ηG - X ηF = C θ + C' θ'
